verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing supports background automation via transaction rules that automatically approve/decline authorizations without manual intervention, plus relayed authorization webhooks with configurable fallback logic when no response is given in time — both function as autonomous decisioning running in the background rather than requiring live user action. However, this is narrowly scoped to card-authorization decisions, not general-purpose agentic automation setup (no evidence of scheduling, triggers beyond transactions, or broader workflow automation across the platform). Missing for 10: evidence of broader autonomous automation beyond transaction/authorization rules, no explicit AI-agent tooling or orchestration framework, no independent corroboration of these automations running reliably unattended.
